subject: general
question: Find the single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of 25% and 10%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

If two successive discounts say D1% and D2% are given, then the direct formula to calculate the equivalent discount is

D% = D1 + D2 - D1 × D2/100 

Here, D1% = 25%, D2% = 10%

D% = 25 + 10 - 25 × 10/100

⇒ D% = 32.5%

**∴ The single discount equivalent is 32.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

The two successive discounts are 25% and 10%

**Calculation:**

Let the Mark Price be 100

Selling Price after two discounts = 100 × 0.75 × 0.90 = 67.5

Total Discount = 100 - 67.5 = 32.5

**∴ The single discount equivalent to two successive discounts of 25% and 10% is 32.5%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**Discount % is always calculated on Mark Price

Discount = (Mark price - Selling price)/Mark price × 100

Profit % is always calculated on the Cost price

Profit = (Selling price - Cost price)/Cost price × 100
